messages: maria: heads-up — after last night's kernel-selector rollout we see ~12% host CPU overhead regression on small requests, mostly in parse/tokenize. aj: ouch. is that in prod only or repros locally? maria: prod and staging repro. deploy @ 03:12 UTC. p99 tokenization climbs 6ms -> 14ms, p95 up ~40%. flame samples point at host::parse_line -> tokenize -> grpc::writev hot path. riley: my first guess is batching heuristics not coalescing tiny requests, so we end up with many tiny minibatches and extra syscall/writev churn chen: added to this — KV cache metrics jump around the same timestamp. eviction rate ×3, cache miss ratio 0.27 -> 0.63 on affected hosts. could be cache key fragmentation from kernel variant differences maria: exactly. the new kernel variant introduced a "mini-frame" fast path. it changes framing and forces an extra copy in the preparse shim before tokenization. aj: any quick traces or logs? can you paste the sample stack or the perf counters? maria: paste of sample snippet (from perf script): ``` parse_line tokenize_utf8 preparse_memcpy grpc_writev ``` Most stacks show preparse_memcpy as the immediate delta compared to baseline. sam: +1 on coalescing. If grpc writev sees many tiny iovecs we pay kernel overhead per iov write. cheap mitigation: coalesce small writes into one buffer on host side before writev. riley: also check that batching heuristic's threshold didn't get lowered accidentally when selector chose mini-frame — we expect fewer tokens per batch. might need to bump thresholds for mini-frame. chen: i'll run a canary revert to the previous kernel flags and replay the same request mix in staging. if kvcache/miss returns to baseline that points to key-format diff. aj: I'll prepare a targeted flame and perf counter run (CPU cycles, cache-misses, context-switches) across canary and baseline. maria: suggested quick fixes: - revert kernel-selector flag on canary hosts (chen) - add short-term coalesce in grpc/proxy write path for smallwrite burst (riley) - instrument miniwrite rate + kvcache key shape telemetry + alert (sam) - run 30m canary load tests and collect p50/p95/p99 + kvcache metrics (aj) chen: kicking off canary revert now. infra-bot should show pipeline. infra-bot: deploy pipeline started for canary-revert (canary-hosts-4) — build #2021 maria: thanks team. if revert fixes it we still need the coalesce + a long-term fix in selector to avoid creating fragmented cache keys. sync in 30m with updated numbers :thumbsup:
